verdict.rationale: Zep publishes a full OpenAPI 3.1 spec covering 148 paths at api.getzep.com/api/v4. It also has Fern-rendered SDK reference pages with an in-page "Try it" API explorer, official SDKs, a versioned API, deprecation notices and migration maps. Everyday operations such as thread.add_messages, graph edge deletion and user deletion are documented as API calls. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of using the API in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
